sec.title: September 6 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 858)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 6** across Rudy Vallee welcoming Billie Burke on *The Drene Show* (1945), Ann Sothern's Catskills resort comedy on *The Adventures of Maisie* (1946), Erle Stanley Gardner's courtroom drama on *A Life in Your Hands* (1949), broadcast pioneer Don Pierson interviewed on *Bob Elson Interviews* (1980), wartime Portuguese espionage on *Hollywood Radio Theater* (1943), and cold-case audio mystery on CBC's *The Mystery Project* (1997).
All episode titles strictly adhere to clean canonical naming, with performer, sponsor, and network details recorded in the narrative description:
